summary: Mistwalker and Microsoft's standalone turn-based RPG about immortality, memory, and a magical industrial revolution.

entries.title: Lost Odyssey

emulation.notes: Use official Xbox backward compatibility rather than unofficial Xbox 360 emulation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Xbox backward-compatible output on Series X/S.

primary.why: Lost Odyssey is an Xbox 360 exclusive that is backward compatible on modern Xbox hardware and is available digitally, making Xbox Series X/S the best current official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the digital Xbox version or an owned Xbox 360 disc through Xbox One or Xbox Series X/S backward compatibility.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster exists; this is a backward-compatible Xbox 360 release.
